title: Stokes' theorem on the parameter cube of a lattice face
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, ρ > 0, F = (z, α) ∈ LatticeFaceIndex (m+1) P, and let ω be a smooth (C^∞) m-form on ℝ^P (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) m with IsSmoothForm ω). Put e_l = EuclideanSpace.single l 1, p = Σ_l ρ z_l e_l, A(s) = p + Σ_j s_j e_{α(j)} for s ∈ ℝ^{m+1}, α_i = α ∘ succAbove_i (= (Fin.succAboveOrderEmb i).trans α) and u_i = (e_{α_i(0)}, …, e_{α_i(m−1)}). Then ∫_{[0,ρ]^{m+1}} dω(A(s))(e_{α(0)}, …, e_{α(m)}) ds = Σ_{i=0}^{m} (−1)^i ( ∫_{[0,ρ]^m} ω(Σ_l ρ (z + e_{α(i)})_l e_l + Σ_j s'_j e_{α_i(j)})(u_i) ds' − ∫_{[0,ρ]^m} ω(p + Σ_j s'_j e_{α_i(j)})(u_i) ds' ). Here z + e_{α(i)} = z + Pi.single (α i) 1 ∈ ℤ^P, and all integrals are Lebesgue integrals over Set.Icc 0 (fun _ => ρ) in Fin (m+1) → ℝ, respectively Fin m → ℝ.
